title: Characters: bible, turnaround sheets, location plates
judge_notes: characters/sheets/<ID>.png is one character's turnaround sheet: four views of the same person on a plain background (head front, head three-quarter, head profile, full body front). characters/plates/<ID>.png is an empty location plate. IDs are the screenplay.json bible ids. characters/bible.md is the in-depth bible; it carries the screenplay's character and location blocks word for word.

questions.text: Is characters/bible.md present and not empty?
Are the screenplay's character, wardrobe and location blocks word for word in characters/bible.md?
Does every real person in the bibles have a CONSENT.md naming them, the film, channels, duration and a date?
Does every character have a sheet and every location a plate?
Does every sheet show four views of the same person (head front, head three-quarter, head profile, full body)?
questions.evidence: Name each sheet and the views it shows.

questions.text: Does each sheet match its bible: face, skin, hair, build and the fixed details?
Does each sheet show the wardrobe its bible names?
Is it clearly the same person in every view of a sheet (same face, same proportions)?
Are hands natural with five fingers wherever they are visible?
Is every sheet and plate free of text, letters, logos, emblems, insignia and number plates?
questions.evidence: Quote nothing for a yes; for a no, name the file and where the text or mark is.

questions.text: Does every location in the screenplay have a plate that matches its bible (layout, window and door side, light)?
questions.evidence: Name each plate and what matches.

questions.text: Does characters/bible.md describe each character in depth: face, skin, hair, build, wardrobe per scene, fixed details?
Is every face free of a likeness to a famous or real person who is not named in CONSENT.md?
questions.evidence: Name any face that looks like a known person.
